findings.body: Checking and installing the SDK for Claude coordinators is separate cold-reader setup work; neither per-item locking nor crash cleanup requires it. This also introduces unnecessary out-of-scope changes in tests/test_codex_setup.py. The diagnostic rewrites at doctor.py lines 129 and 132 and their tests/test_setup.py changes are unrelated, and tests/conftest.py line 102 duplicates the existing environment reset at line 109. Remove these additions while retaining doctor cleanup and the reader lifecycle integration needed to protect active readers.
findings.title: Simpler: unrelated doctor setup changes → existing setup behavior
